_README: Client work entries. To add a project: copy the _EXAMPLE object, paste it inside the 'items' list, and edit its values. Separate entries with a comma. Optional fields you can delete if unused: client, featured, comingSoon, link, cover. IMAGES: drop an image into public/work/ (e.g. public/work/my-project.jpg) and set 'cover' to '/work/my-project.jpg'. After editing, refresh the dev server (npm run dev) to see changes.

_EXAMPLE.title: Project Title
_EXAMPLE.description: One or two sentences describing what you built and the value it delivered.

items.title: Example Client Project
items.description: A full-stack web platform built for a client, featuring user authentication, a dashboard, and real-time data. Replace this with your real project description.
